prior_limits.reason: Rivals share exact coverage and retain unknowns; generated knowledge graphs or prose can only rename latent roles unless a held contrast breaks the symmetry.

identifiability_diagnosis.core_problem: Unknown-label permutation symmetry: a model can fit form, topic and layout while any bijection of opaque labels to English meanings fits equally. Topic/layout dependence can also create homographs, so recurrence alone cannot choose a translation.
identifiability_diagnosis.what_old_routes_lacked: An independently sourced endpoint and a predeclared held prediction that changes under rival lexical assignments. More fluent renditions, graph joins, or raw structural passes do not supply that constraint.
identifiability_diagnosis.positive_evidence_standard: Infer meanings jointly as latent variables only when multiple source-bound constraints overdetermine them: repeated complete forms, independently fixed owner/role endpoints, matched contrasts and held folios. Report unresolved equivalence classes when renaming symmetry remains.

plans.mechanism: Fit a finite latent lexicon jointly with record/owner roles. Keep complete unknown wholes opaque; use the existing 45 visual keys as source-bound endpoint variables and repeated prose/diagram occurrences as constraints. Permit three rivals: invariant lexical core with topic-specific realization; topic-conditioned homography; layout-only procedural marker with no stable content.
positive_evidence_needed: At least five independently provenance-bound owner/part/state endpoints across held physical folios, with two-reader agreement and alternate-reading preservation.

The same unknown whole recurs in at least two disjoint folio contexts with the same endpoint, while a predeclared contrasting whole tracks a different endpoint; topic and page are nuisance variables rather than labels.
A held combination of known owner/record features predicts an endpoint or whole choice before its meaning is assigned.
plans.untouched_prediction: On held folios, the invariant-core model predicts the same latent endpoint relation for a repeated whole despite topic/layout change; the homography model predicts owner/topic-specific reassignment; the layout-only model predicts role/position but no endpoint association.
plans.falsifier: All assignments remain equally permutable, the held endpoint prediction is no better than topic/layout-only rivals, or apparent transfer disappears when owner and folio are held out. Then preserve only an equivalence class, not a translation.
plans.acquisition_if_45_insufficient: Acquire a small targeted set of new native keys designed to split the remaining permutation classes: same source family, repeated endpoint, independent readers, and untouched held folios. More generic visual coverage does not help unless it breaks a specific symmetry.

plans.mechanism: Use source-native matched pairs where one observable dimension changes while owner/topic is held: field order, state transition, quantity/stage slot, or downstream action. Infer the unknown whole and endpoint jointly from contrast constraints. Permit a topic-dependent lexical model and a layout-conditioned renderer model as explicit rivals.
positive_evidence_needed: Predeclare matched pairs with complete whole boundaries and source-bound structural roles; no imported English gloss may define the contrast.
Require one independently bound endpoint or process relation per pair, then test whether the same whole follows the endpoint across distinct topics or whether only layout predicts it.
Reserve untouched folios and alternate readings for the final contrast; do not score the same paragraph used to choose the pair.
plans.untouched_prediction: A lexical model predicts the same contrastive role when the layout is changed but the source-bound relation is preserved; a renderer model predicts only position/order; a topic-homography model predicts systematic reassignment by owner/topic.
plans.falsifier: No pair isolates one dimension, or all rival models make identical predictions after allowing topic/layout effects. A structural pass without a divergent endpoint prediction is retained as structure only.
plans.acquisition_if_45_insufficient: Add only keys that create the missing matched contrast, preferably an endpoint pair on an untouched folio; do not expand to a generic decoder or broad image census.

implementation_ceiling.first_gate: Freeze rival commitments, endpoint provenance, held folios and the allowed relabeling symmetry before fitting any meanings.
implementation_ceiling.no_gold_blanket: Structural constraints can be evaluated without semantic gold; semantic inference begins only where independent endpoints and rival-divergent held predictions exist.
implementation_ceiling.translation_claim: A word-level translation is reportable only after a nontrivial latent assignment survives both plans or one plan plus a held cross-topic/owner prediction. Otherwise report source-bound functional roles and the remaining equivalence class.
